razonamiento: CloudFormation and Auto Scaling (ASG) are deployment/management components with no active edges in the visual reading or spoken runtime flows, so they are omitted per rule 7. The EC2 instances (b3, b4, b5) are preserved as distinct nodes because they exhibit distinct topological connections (b3 and b4 connect to Direct Connect, while b5 connects to TWD/CNN Center). On-premises facilities (NYC Direct Connect location/PoP, TWD/CNN Center, and ATL broadcast distribution) are mapped to OnPremDC.
